description: This Java source file defines a Spring Boot configuration class for the Eclipse Hono COAP Adapter, including bean definitions, configuration properties, and metrics customization.

classes.name: Config
classes.description: Spring Boot configuration class for the Hono COAP Adapter, providing bean definitions for the adapter, properties, and metrics customization.

methods.name: vertxBasedCoapAdapter
methods.description: Creates and returns a new instance of VertxBasedCoapAdapter with prototype scope.

methods.name: customizeDownstreamSenderFactoryConfig
methods.description: Overrides parent method to set default name for downstream sender factory config if not set.

methods.name: customizeRegistrationClientFactoryConfig
methods.description: Overrides parent method to set default name for registration client factory config if not set.

methods.name: customizeCredentialsClientFactoryConfig
methods.description: Overrides parent method to set default name for credentials client factory config if not set.

methods.name: customizeTenantClientFactoryConfig
methods.description: Overrides parent method to set default name for tenant client factory config if not set.

methods.name: adapterProperties
methods.description: Defines a Spring bean exposing CoapAdapterProperties with configuration prefix 'hono.coap'.

methods.name: commonTags
methods.description: Creates a MeterRegistryCustomizer to add common tags to metrics related to the COAP protocol adapter.

methods.name: serviceFactory
methods.description: Creates a factory bean to produce instances of VertxBasedCoapAdapter.
